analysis.title: Patterson-UTI Energy Inc. (PTEN): 3Q26 First Take: Stronger EBITDA vs GS and Street; Focus on 2027 Activity and Pricing Commentary on Call
key_insights: PTEN reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $264 mil, 3% above the GS estimate of $257 mil and 2% above FactSet consensus of $260 mil.
Revenue of $1,342 mil was 4% above the GS estimate, driven by Drilling Products (+18% vs GS) and Completion Services (+6% vs GS), partly offset by Drilling Services (-2% vs GS).
EBITDA margin was 19.7% vs GS 19.9%. Completion Services margin was 192 bps below GS, offset by Drilling Services (+143 bps vs GS) and Drilling Products (+538 bps vs GS).
Based on the GS assumption of ~31 fleets, GS estimates PTEN achieved EBITDA/fleet of $16.1 mil vs GS estimate of $16.5 mil.
Free cash flow was $159.6 mil vs GS estimate of $109.8 mil and $(97.2) mil in 2Q26.
Operating income was $63.3 mil vs GS $33.0 mil, helped by $18.0 mil of other operating income. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.07 vs GS $0.03.

4Q26 guidance for Drilling Services: average rig count of ~104 (in line with GS ~104), with an exit above that level in 2026 and additional rig reactivations in 1Q27. Adjusted gross profit ~$150 mil (GS $150 mil).
4Q26 guidance for Completion Services: adjusted gross profit ~$140 mil vs GS $132 mil, attributed to activity levels and pricing improvements.
4Q26 guidance for Drilling Products: adjusted gross profit to decline 5-10% sequentially. Other adjusted gross profit is expected to be steady with 3Q26.
4Q26 SG&A guided to ~$70 mil and depreciation, depletion, amortization and impairment to ~$220 mil.

GS rates PTEN Buy with a 12-month price target of $12 against a $12.60 close on 28 Oct 2026, implying 4.8% downside. The target rests on 4.5x through-cycle EV/EBITDA and a 13.0% through-cycle FCF yield.
GS focus for the call is 2027 activity and pricing commentary.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA beat GS and consensus, and 4Q26 Completion Services gross profit guidance is above GS. The $12 target sits 4.8% below the $12.60 price.
